text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day after the Tenno Sho, Mejiro McQueen gets a call from her grandmother, who entrusts McQueen with showing the Mejiro family a new path forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The suddenness of this request leaves Mejiro McQueen struggling to sort out her thoughts and feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she receives encouragement from Mejiro Ryan, who declares her desire to become even stronger. Ryan then challenges McQueen to another showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: McQueen sees her sister's resolve and accepts the challenge to compete in the Takarazuka Kinen, saying her victory will display her resolve to shoulder the responsibility of the Mejiro name.
